description.value: Riverbrew Cafe is a community-focused cafe tucked in the Sun Rivers neighbourhood of Kamloops, founded by Bella — a local resident with a background in business and a passion for homemade food and genuine hospitality. The menu spans breakfast sandwiches, a wide range of lunch sandwiches and paninis, and a creative lineup of specialty 'dirty sodas,' plus catering for small events and meetings. Outdoor seating is available, and the cafe operates seven days a week.

No bike-specific amenities (rack, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned on the website; OSM tags outdoor_seating=yes and internet_access=wlan but neither is confirmed in the website text, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules.
